info.description: 仅针对独立的 dhu_secondhand_acceptance 本地测试库。先初始化，选择配套环境，然后按顺序运行完整集合。使用 Postman 默认 Cookie jar；每次切换身份均正常退出和登录。不会发送邮件。

exec: pm.test("HTTP 204", function () { if (pm.response.code !== 204) throw new Error("Unexpected HTTP " + pm.response.code); });
pm.test("HTTP 401", function () { if (pm.response.code !== 401) throw new Error("Unexpected HTTP " + pm.response.code); });
pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error("Unexpected HTTP " + pm.response.code); });
var data = pm.response.json();
pm.test("账号身份正确", function () { if (!(data.email === pm.environment.get("sellerEmail") && data.role === "USER")) throw new Error("Response did not match"); });
pm.environment.set("sellerId", data.id);
